name: Bangalabarta
description: A benchmark dataset for detecting spam and smishing SMS messages in mobile communication (targeting the Bangla language/region implied by the name).
reputation: A region/language-specific SMS spam dataset (Bangla) with modest adoption in regional NLP and spam-detection research but not a global standard.
notes: Small, language-specific dataset with likely class imbalance; not an LLM-specific benchmark; models may benefit from language-specific resources or transliteration handling.
